description: HAL PWM on three timers: TIM2 CH1 PA0 1 kHz 25 %, TIM3 CH1 PA6 20 kHz 50 %, TIM1 CH1 PA8 2 kHz 75 % (MOE via HAL_TIM_PWM_Start)
expect: 72 MHz; TIM2/TIM3 count TIMXCLK1 = 72 MHz (APB1 36 MHz x2), TIM1 TIMXCLK2 = 72 MHz. PWM mode 1, active high, every period starts with a rising edge at the update event. PA0 (TIM2 CH1, PSC 71, ARR 999, CCR1 250): 1 kHz, 250 us high / 750 us low. PA6 (TIM3 CH1, PSC 0, ARR 3599, CCR1 1800): 20 kHz, 25 us high / 25 us low. PA8 (TIM1 CH1, PSC 71, ARR 499, CCR1 375): 2 kHz, 375 us high / 125 us low - only because HAL_TIM_PWM_Start sets TIM1_BDTR.MOE. Edges are exact multiples of the 13.9 ns timer clock (no jitter, no drift); the three outputs are independent (each timer is started separately). The CPU sleeps in __WFI(). No UART.

circuit: PA0, PA6, PA8: logic analyzer probes (no load needed)
